criteria.criterion: Producer provenance and independent current consumer
criteria.finding: Two actual producer PURE Work results flow through producer source/publication/disclosure Roots, signed Gate5 evidence, independently bootstrapped recipient trust, current local Root and full consumer Work.

criteria.criterion: Current imported material changes actual Work
criteria.finding: Actual baseline lacks support price; revision 1 price 3 yields 20 + 2*3 = 26 and revision 2 price 4 yields 28 in distinct admitted native invocations.

criteria.criterion: Disclosure refusal prevents body read and consumption
criteria.finding: Signed request-bound REFUSED has no body/manifest and no consumption. The separate peer-private read attempt is refused before bytes/hash, under the admitted application fence.

criteria.criterion: New admitted revision is consumed; old history retained
criteria.finding: Revision 2 has fresh producer and consumer Work plus lineage and high-water 2. Both complete historical accepted-result records remain byte-equal across the recipient restart.

criteria.criterion: Current status, expiry and restart prevent rollback
criteria.finding: Actual signed REVOKED and persisted terminal/source high-waters survive a reaped recipient and fresh signer/process. Old ACTIVE/revision and labeled controlled future expiry are refused before new Work.

criteria.criterion: Signed bytes, issuer/anchor and scope are enforced
criteria.finding: Altered pointer/signature/body, wrong anchor/issuer/scope each retain exact refusal reason, blocked Root and unchanged Work count; public send/receive pairs and actual positive artifact bindings agree.

criteria.criterion: History, accounting and process closure are retained
criteria.finding: Historical resolver exposes two candidates requiring Root review and no direct reuse/permission/network. Three incarnations exit 0 and are reaped, lock released, zero model/AUTH/E/SAVE and ten historical guards exact.

limits: Acceptance is limited to the approved local two-peer informational profile and seven frozen Stage06 criteria.
Controlled future expiry is a labeled negative lane, not a naturally elapsed expiry observation.
The review checks retained accepted cryptographic/native evidence and source identities without rerunning cryptography or validators.
Application-level peer I/O isolation is not OS sandboxing against malicious same-UID code.
No arbitrary remote federation, global production DRS, Stage07/U3, general SAVE/effect permission or model capability is accepted.
No new owner command, retry, source mutation, activation, model or native execution is authorized by this review.
Owner timing is the saved supervisor measurement, not an independently captured full Terminal wall duration.
